bias.zh: 反弹 · 失守 $372，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Applied Materials fell 2.7% on Nov 13 to $370.50, trading $352.23–381.22 on heavy volume (1.43x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($377.9), above the 10-day ($366.7) and below the 30-day ($417.2), 100-day ($488.0) and 200-day ($446.5); the 5-day and 200-day are rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($320.43), and RSI is 42.6.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月13日下跌 2.7%，收于 $370.50，盘中区间 $352.23–381.22，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.43 倍）。股价位于 5 日均线（$377.9）下方、10 日均线（$366.7）上方，30 日（$417.2）、100 日（$488.0）和 200 日均线（$446.5）下方；5 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 于 11月11日上穿信号线，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$320.43），RSI 为 42.6。

read.en: The close lost the $372–376 support and the 5-day, now resistance, but recovered from $352.23 to hold the 10-day. Resistance is $376–381.2 (5-day, Nov 13 high), then $390.1–397.2 and $404.7 (Nov 11 high). Support is $366.7 (10-day), then $343–352 (Nov 9 and 13 lows) and $317–320 (Nov 5 low, SAR). A close above $381.2 would target $390–397; below $366.7, $352.

r.en: 5-day average $377.9; Oct 23 low $372.8 and Nov 12 low $376.09, lost; Nov 13 high $381.22
